description: Worker: ingest, store, and expose the channel dimension (plan tasks 1-5). Add the channel column + index via migration 0005, promote properties.channel to the column at ingest, add channel as a third global filter in handleKpis and buildDetailFilter, and add a /details/channels breakdown endpoint reusing computeCohortRetention. Decisions made: promote channel to a real indexed column (not json_extract), reserved value 'organic' => channel IS NULL, breakdown delivered via a new /details/channels endpoint (not a byChannel array), and pure helpers (extractChannel, buildChannelClause, summarizeChannelBreakdown) extracted so the SQL handlers' logic is unit-testable in the pure node test runner. Independent of FEAT-003; FEAT-002 depends on this (needs /details/channels and the ?channel= param).
steps: Task 1: create analytics-worker/migrations/0005_add_channel_column.sql mirroring 0002: `ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN channel TEXT;` then `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_channel ON events (channel);`. Append the two 0005 lines to the db:migrate:local and db:migrate:remote script chains in analytics-worker/package.json. Verify on LOCAL D1 only: `npx wrangler d1 execute analytics-db --local --file=migrations/0005_add_channel_column.sql` then PRAGMA table_info(events) shows `channel` and PRAGMA index_list(events) shows idx_events_channel. Do NOT run --remote here.

Task 2: in handlePostEvents (src/index.ts ~L123-152) add an exported pure helper extractChannel(event) returning the string when typeof event.properties?.channel === 'string' and non-empty, else null. Add `channel` to the INSERT column list and one more `?` (12 placeholders total), and bind the extracted value in positional order (choose a slot, keep INSERT column order === bind order). Leave the properties JSON serialization unchanged (channel stays inside it).

Task 3: add exported pure helper buildChannelClause(channelParam, col='channel') => {sql, params}: null/''/'all' => {sql:'', params:[]}; 'organic' => {sql:' AND '+col+' IS NULL', params:[]}; else => {sql:' AND '+col+' = ?', params:[label]}. In handleKpis read url channel param and, AFTER the cohort append, do dateFilter += ch.sql; dateParams.push(...ch.params) so it flows through every withFilter query. For the table-qualified activation JOIN and wallet-growth builders, append buildChannelClause(channelParam, 'events.channel') / ('tc.channel') to their inner/outer filter+params exactly like the cohort clause is appended there. In buildDetailFilter append buildChannelClause(channelParam) to clause/params after the cohort block. Confirm the N-times param binding still matches clause occurrences in handleDetailUsers (4x) and handleDetailOnboarding (2x) — the channel `?` now rides inside `clause`, so no new counting code, just verify counts.

Task 4a: add exported pure summarizeChannelBreakdown(installRows, activationRows, cohortRows, nowISO, minSample=20): for each distinct channel + an 'organic' bucket (channel IS NULL), compute installs (count), activation {rate,num,den}, walletGrowth {count}, and retention via computeCohortRetention(thatChannelsCohortRows, nowISO, [7,30]); when a channel's denominator < minSample return the count with rate:null and smallSample:true (mirror computeCohortRetention's pct:null n/a convention). Add handleDetailChannels(request, env) templated on handleDetailPlatforms: use buildDetailFilter for phase+cohort+exclusion (NOT the channel filter — breakdown shows all channels), run GROUP BY channel SQL for installs/activation/wallet-add plus the per-user+channel cohort rows (reuse the cohortSql shape adding channel to SELECT/GROUP BY), pass to summarizeChannelBreakdown, return JSON. Register `/details/channels` in the router next to `/details/platforms`.

Task 4b: create src/channel.test.ts (node:test, explicit .ts imports of the three exported helpers; mirror retention.test.ts style with a fixed TODAY and a CohortUserRow builder). Cases: extractChannel with/without properties.channel and with missing/empty/non-string; buildChannelClause reddit/organic/absent/all + custom column; summarizeChannelBreakdown separates channels, places untagged in 'organic', a too-small channel returns count+rate:null+smallSample:true, an at/above-minSample channel returns a real rate, and the cohort-retention column equals computeCohortRetention for that channel's rows.

Task 4c: add a THROWAWAY analytics-worker/scripts/seed-channels.local.sql inserting synthetic events across channels (reddit, linkedin, NULL/organic) with app_opened + tool_completed + days_since_install, inside and outside a phase window. Apply migrations + seed to local D1, then run targeted SELECTs (via `npx wrangler d1 execute analytics-db --local --command=...`) mirroring the handler SQL to confirm: channel='reddit' scopes to reddit only; channel IS NULL returns only untagged; composing with a timestamp >=/< window + the cohort subquery works. Record commands + observed counts in findings. DELETE the seed script before committing and grep to confirm it is gone.

Task 5 (deploy — operator step if creds present): run migration 0005 against REMOTE D1 FIRST (`npx wrangler d1 execute analytics-db --remote --file=migrations/0005_add_channel_column.sql`), then `npm run deploy`. Verify /health ok, /kpis shape unchanged (channel additive), /details/channels returns an all-organic breakdown. If wrangler auth / DASHBOARD_SECRET are unavailable in this environment, stop at local verification and record in findings that remote migration + deploy are an operator step — do NOT block the branch.
acceptance_criteria: migrations/0005_add_channel_column.sql exists, adds the channel TEXT column and idx_events_channel, and the db:migrate:local/remote chains in package.json include it; applying it to local D1 shows the column + index via PRAGMA.
handlePostEvents stores event.properties.channel into the channel column (null when absent) while leaving the properties JSON unchanged.

A channel query param scopes handleKpis and every /details/* endpoint: a label => AND channel = ?, 'organic' => AND channel IS NULL, absent/all => no predicate; it composes with from/to and cohort=new, and param binding matches clause repetition count.

GET /details/channels returns one row per channel plus an organic (channel IS NULL) row, each with installs, activation (rate + raw num/den), wallet growth, and cohort retention; a too-small channel shows its count with a suppressed (null) rate.
`cd analytics-worker && npm test` passes including the new src/channel.test.ts cases, and `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes.
The local-D1 seed script is removed before commit (git status clean of it).
verification: cd analytics-worker && npm install && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json  (must pass)
cd analytics-worker && npm test  (all existing retention tests + new channel.test.ts pass)

cd analytics-worker && npx wrangler d1 execute analytics-db --local --file=migrations/0005_add_channel_column.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute analytics-db --local --command="PRAGMA table_info(events);"  (shows channel column) and --command="PRAGMA index_list(events);"  (shows idx_events_channel)
Local-D1 SELECTs over the seed data confirm reddit-scoping, organic=untagged-only, and composition with a phase window + cohort subquery (record counts in findings; delete seed script after).
Deploy/remote (operator step if creds available): curl /health ok, /kpis shape unchanged, /details/channels all-organic — otherwise flag as operator step in findings.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (worker channel dimension, plan tasks 1-4; task 5 remote deploy is a pending operator step).

FILES CHANGED:
- analytics-worker/migrations/0005_add_channel_column.sql (new): ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN channel TEXT; + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_channel.
- analytics-worker/package.json: appended the 0005 file to BOTH db:migrate:local and db:migrate:remote chains (note: 0004 was never in the chains; I did not add it, only 0005, to avoid scope creep).
- analytics-worker/src/channel.ts (new): pure helpers extractChannel, buildChannelClause, summarizeChannelBreakdown + exported types (ChannelInstallRow, ChannelActivationRow, ChannelCohortUserRow, ChannelBreakdownEntry, ORGANIC). Put in its OWN module (like retention.ts) because the node test runner cannot import from index.ts (index.ts transitively imports ./dashboard, an extensionless import the runner can't resolve). This keeps the helpers unit-testable.
- analytics-worker/src/index.ts: imports the 3 helpers; extractChannel wired into handlePostEvents INSERT (channel column added between app_version and country => 12 placeholders, bind order matches column order; properties JSON unchanged, channel stays inside it); channel filter appended to dateFilter/dateParams in handleKpis (after cohort) so it rides every withFilter query; activation JOIN gets buildChannelClause('events.channel')/('tc.channel') on inner/outer; buildDetailFilter appends buildChannelClause(channelParam) to clause/params after the cohort block (so handleDetailUsers 4x / handleDetailOnboarding 2x bindings carry it automatically — verified counts unchanged); new handleDetailChannels + /details/channels route registered next to /details/platforms.
- analytics-worker/src/channel.test.ts (new): 15 pure-helper tests (extractChannel present/absent/missing-props/empty/non-string; buildChannelClause null/''/all/organic/label/custom-col; summarizeChannelBreakdown channel separation, organic bucketing, small-sample suppression (rate:null+smallSample:true), real rate at/above minSample, cohort-retention column equals computeCohortRetention, organic always present).
- analytics-worker/tsconfig.json: added allowImportingTsExtensions:true (safe with noEmit:true already set) so channel.ts can import './retention.ts' with an explicit extension that the node test runner also requires. Non-test source still compiles with or without extensions.

CHANNEL PARAM VALUES: ?channel= absent/''/'all' => all channels (no predicate); 'organic' => channel IS NULL (untagged); any other label (e.g. 'reddit') => channel = <label>. Composes with from/to and cohort=new.

/details/channels RESPONSE SHAPE: { "channels": [ { channel: string ('organic' for untagged), installs: number, activation: { rate: number|null, num: number, den: number }, walletGrowth: { count: number }, retention: { "7": {pct:number|null, cohort:number}, "30": {pct:number|null, cohort:number} }, smallSample: boolean } ] }. Entries sorted by installs desc, organic last on ties. rate is null (and smallSample true) when the channel's activation denominator < 20 (minSample). NOTE: handleDetailChannels deliberately STRIPS the ?channel= param before calling buildDetailFilter (the breakdown spans ALL channels; channel is a GROUP BY, not a predicate there) — it still honors phase (from/to), cohort, and exclusion.

VERIFICATION DONE HERE:
- `npm install` + `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` => PASS.
- `npm test` => 22 pass / 0 fail (7 existing retention + 15 new channel).
- Local D1 migration: applied migrations/0005 to local D1; PRAGMA table_info(events) shows `channel`, PRAGMA index_list(events) shows `idx_events_channel`.
- Local D1 SQL-wiring (throwaway seed, now deleted): reddit scopes to reddit only (3 users all-time, 2 in phase window [2026-01-01,2026-02-01) with the Dec install excluded); channel IS NULL returns only the untagged user (1); composition with phase window + cohort=new first-touch subquery works (reddit => 2); per-user+channel cohort rows produced correct max_dsi (u_r1=8 => retained D7). Seed rows DELETED from local D1 and scripts/seed-channels.local.sql removed (grep confirms gone; the only remaining 'seed-channels' string is in this task JSON's description).

HONEST SPLIT: pure helpers are unit-proven; the SQL predicate scoping / organic=untagged / phase+cohort composition is proven on LOCAL D1 (not the unit runner). The /details/channels end-to-end over the live worker is NOT proven here.

PENDING OPERATOR STEP (plan task 5 — NOT a blocker): run migration 0005 against REMOTE D1 FIRST (`cd analytics-worker && npx wrangler d1 execute analytics-db --remote --file=migrations/0005_add_channel_column.sql`), THEN `npm run deploy`. Requires operator wrangler auth + DASHBOARD_SECRET, unavailable in this environment. Post-deploy spot-check: /health ok, /kpis shape unchanged (channel additive), /details/channels returns an all-organic breakdown pre-app-release. FEAT-002 depends on this (needs /details/channels + the ?channel= param, both delivered).
